name: Arminak Solutions LLC dba KBL Cosmetics
summary: Arminak Solutions LLC dba KBL Cosmetics commits to sustainable procurement across its supply chain, emphasizing ethical sourcing, environmental stewardship, and fair labor practices. The company sets measurable targets for emissions, water use, packaging sustainability, supplier compliance, and transparency through audits and reporting.
tagline: Sourcing beauty responsibly for a cleaner, fairer future.

company.name: Arminak Solutions LLC dba KBL Cosmetics

declaration.preface:
Arminak Solutions LLC dba KBL Cosmetics is dedicated to ethical business operations and environmental sustainability. We are committed to lowering our carbon footprint, protecting natural resources, and advancing sustainable development because, as a business in the beauty and personal care sector, we understand the potential environmental impact of our activities.

Arminak Solutions LLC dba KBL Cosmetics is committed to designing, manufacturing, and delivering high-quality cosmetic products while operating in a manner that protects the environment and promotes the sustainable use of natural resources. Our approach includes responsible sourcing of ingredients, water conservation, efficient use of raw materials, waste reduction, and clean energy utilization, while fostering sustainability across our entire value chain.

We set annual environmental goals, develop the necessary capabilities, and allocate appropriate resources to achieve this policy through innovation, operational efficiency, and ensuring our supply chain aligns with our sustainability commitments.

declaration.scope: This policy applies to all employees, stakeholders, contractors, partners, customers, contractual workers, and anyone acting on behalf of following sites:

focusAreas: Responsible raw material and chemical management

Environmental Compliance: Ethical Ingredient Sourcing: We prioritize the use of ethically sourced, organic, and sustainable ingredients in our products, ensuring they are free from harsh chemicals and toxins.
Water Conservation: We implement measures to reduce water usage and promote recycling within our operations.
Energy Efficiency: We invest in energy-efficient technologies and waste reduction measures to minimize our environmental footprint.
Waste Reduction: We minimize waste generation and promote recycling throughout our operations and supply chain.
Sustainable Packaging: We choose eco-friendly packaging options, such as recycled materials and biodegradable containers, to reduce waste.
Product Development: We develop products with minimal environmental impact during their use phase, including creating biodegradable and compostable products.
Customer Health and Safety: We ensure customer health and safety by adhering to stringent quality control and safety standards.
Sustainable Consumption: We promote sustainable consumption by advocating for environmentally friendly alternatives to synthetic materials.

Product End-of-Life: We promote responsible end-of-life management of products and packaging by supporting reuse, recycling, compostability, refillable systems, and environmentally responsible disposal practices to reduce landfill waste and encourage circular economy principles.

15% of our product lines to waterless or low-water formulations

achieve a 20% reduction in total waste generated
achieve zero landfill waste
ensure that 50% of agricultural raw materials are grown using regenerative farming practices

use 50% biodegradable or recyclable packaging for all products
eliminate the use of per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) in all products
30% decrease in Volatile Organic Compounds (VOCs) emissions
25% reduction in particulate matter emissions
15% reduction in transportation-related air pollution
15% reduction in overall noise levels

responsibilities.duty: Oversees the overall environmental strategy and approves long-term sustainability goals.
Ensures alignment of environmental initiatives with business objectives and stakeholder expectations.
Leads the development and implementation of the Environmental policy across the organization.
Reports directly to the CEO and provides regular updates to the Board of Directors.
Provides leadership in implementing the Environmental policy within their respective divisions.
Allocates necessary resources and integrates sustainability metrics into performance evaluations.
A dedicated sustainability committee comprising representatives from various departments is established to oversee the execution of sustainability initiatives.
The committee is tasked with developing action plans, monitoring performance, and recommending improvements to meet sustainability objectives.
Departmental heads are responsible for integrating sustainability practices into their respective areas of operation.
They ensure compliance with environmental regulations, promote resource efficiency, and support employee engagement in sustainability efforts.
Ensures adherence to all applicable environmental laws, regulations, and standards.
Conducts regular audits and maintains documentation for regulatory compliance.
All employees are encouraged to actively participate in sustainability initiatives.
They are expected to adhere to sustainable practices, report any environmental concerns, and contribute ideas for continuous improvement.

policy.monitoring:
An annual performance review is conducted to assess progress towards sustainability goals and targets.

Key achievements, challenges, and areas for improvement are identified through a comprehensive evaluation process.

Feedback from performance reviews, internal audits, and stakeholder engagement activities is used to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

Adjustments to strategies, policies, and action plans are made as necessary to enhance sustainability performance and address emerging issues.

The Chief Sustainability Officer reviews this policy annually to ensure alignment with changing regulatory requirements, industry best practices, and stakeholder expectations.

Company can also change or review policy if any necessary changes is required.

Updates to the policy are communicated internally, and relevant training is provided to ensure awareness and compliance.
